card.name: Space before a number and unit
card.fires_on: The space just before a number that gives a quantity, such as a volume in mL, days or quarts. Mostly in dosing and device instructions for oral liquids and syringes.

modes.label: Space before volume
modes.description: The space after a word like 'a' or 'is', right before a volume figure in mL or quarts.

modes.label: Space before a duration
modes.description: The space right before a number of days.
